card.name: Linking words in diagnosis-consideration phrases
card.fires_on: Small words right before a symptom or finding in sentences about diagnosing or ruling out a condition, such as 'considered for diarrhea' or 'undiagnosed bleeding'. It also fires on 'un-' type words meaning unexplained.
